English language proficiency
Since English is the primary language of instruction and communication at McGill, you must demonstrate an adequate level of proficiency in English, regardless of your citizenship status or country of origin.
McGill University has this language requirement to ensure that all students will have the opportunity for success in their chosen program. Below you will find information on when and how to provide proof of proficiency.
Proof of proficiency – required
In each case below, you must ensure that the official test results are sent directly to McGill University by the testing service. For IELTS, applications cannot be considered if test results are not available. Some programs require a higher score. Please consult the application requirements of your program of interest.
If you do not meet any of the Proof of proficiency - not required conditions, you must demonstrate proficiency in English using one of the following options:
TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language)
IBT (Internet-Based Test):
6-point scale (as of January 2026)
Minimum overall score of 4.5
Minimum component scores:
Reading 4.5
Listening 4.5
Writing 4.5
Speaking 4.0
120-point scale
Minimum overall score of 86
Minimum component scores of 20
The McGill Institution Code is 0935
McGill does not accept TOEFL’s MyBest™ scores.
N.B. an institutional version of the TOEFL is not acceptable.
IELTS (International English Language Testing System)
A band score of 6.5 or greater (Academic module)
The regular Academic test and the UKVI test are all accepted. A band score of 6.5 or better. For further information: IELTS website.
McGill accepts only scores submitted electronically by an IELTS test center, and no longer accepts paper TRFs (Test Report Forms) directly from test centres and candidates. Please contact the test center where you took the IELTS test and request that your test scores be sent electronically to McGill. Students cannot upload their results themselves, nor can administration upload paper copies of their results. You can verify receipt of your results directly in the application portal; please allow an appropriate delay as McGill receives IELTS results on an ongoing basis.
McGill does not accept the IELTS Online test
McGill does not accept the IELTS One Skill Retake
Important note to applicants considering the IELTS test: We have received several reports from applicants of significantly delayed delivery of scores from various IELTs test centres. If you choose to take the IELTS test, please allow extra time for delivery and make sure that the test centre is clear on the mechanism to send results to McGill.
McGill Certificate of Proficiency in English or McGill Certificate of Proficiency – English for Professional Communication
Certificate or Proficiency awarded.
Please note that these are minimum acceptable scores. The McGill graduate department to which you are applying may require higher test scores. Please verify the program-specific requirements by visiting the department website.
Please note that the Duolingo English Test (DET) and the Pearson's PTE test are not accepted for admission to graduate programs at McGill University.
Proof of proficiency - not required
Normally, if you meet any one of the following conditions you are not required to submit proof of proficiency in English:
Has obtained (or is about to obtain) an undergraduate or graduate degree from a recognized institution in Canada or the United States of America (anglophone or francophone)
Has obtained (or is about to obtain) an undergraduate or graduate degree from a recognized foreign institution where English is the language of instruction
Has lived and attended university, or been employed, for at least four consecutive years, in a country where English is the acknowledged primary language.
Please note that you must send documentation proving you meet one of the conditions directly to your department, who will then waive the English proficiency requirement on your application.
